briefdescription.para: Wave D dedicated benchmark gates for the server module (SRV-BM-01..04).

detaileddescription.para: Provides reproducible p95/p99 latency measurements for the four server paths identified as Wave D operability hardening targets in src/server/ROADMAP.md. All benchmarks use in-process stubs — no real network sockets are required.

sect2.title: Gate table
sect2.para:
All benchmarks:
Use kSrvDgSeed = 42 for deterministic data generation.
Run with Repetitions(5) to capture variance.
No real I/O, no real crypto — structural overhead only.
